newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATUS TO SELL STAKES IN SANITAS AND TAURAS.
newsitem.headline: STATUS TO SELL STAKES IN SANITAS AND TAURAS.

text.p: Lithuanian financial group Status wants to sell its stakes in pharmaceutical producer Sanitas and Vilniaus Tauras brewery, Verslo Zinios newspaper reported on Friday.

The newspaper quoted Kazimieras Liepis, the director of Mendes Prior Europe brokerage house, as saying that Status told dealers that it wants to sell its 53 percent stake in Sanitas and 70 percent stake in Vilniaus Tauras brewery.

Status asked for Sanitas shares around 39 million litas, higher than the market price, but taking into the consideration good financial reports of the company not too high, the newspaper quoted Liepis as saying.
The newspaper said that Status was selling its shares in Vilniaus Tauras, which has some nine percent of the country's beer market, for around 16 million litas.
